description: Artificial companions, inherited consciousness, cloning, neural networks, genetic experimentation and alien captivity drive a season in which scientific breakthroughs repeatedly collide with memory, autonomy and the fragile boundaries of human identity.

s03e01.description: The last man in an underground refuge depends on a sophisticated computer for companionship until its female artificial personality begins demanding genuine love in return.

s03e02.description: A developmentally disabled man receives a dying scientist's memories and intellect, then becomes addicted to absorbing more minds in pursuit of power and affection.

s03e03.description: A grieving mother becomes pregnant using cloned cells from her dead child, raising disturbing questions about whether recreating a life can ever restore the person who was lost.

s03e04.description: A college student brings home a young woman whom his father recognizes from secret military experiments decades earlier, reopening a mystery that should not still be alive.

s03e05.description: When a virus attacks people connected to a global neural information network, humanity's best chance is a man physically unable to join the system everyone else depends on.

s03e06.description: In a future where healthy births are rare, the parents of a naturally healthy baby resist a government determined to take their child for humanity's genetic survival.

s03e07.description: Humans enslaved for generations in an alien prison camp live under android guards until one captive challenges the system and begins discovering what lies beyond it.

s03e08.description: An alien artifact grants extraordinary powers to a group of strangers, and their sudden abilities quickly expose how little restraint ambition provides.

s03e09.description: A survivor of a crashed spacecraft is bitten by an alien creature and can no longer tell whether the threats around him are real or symptoms of an infected mind.

s03e10.description: A woman unable to experience emotion receives a neural implant that opens her to feelings for the first time, but emotional awakening proves anything but controllable.

s03e11.description: A murdered doctor is briefly restored to life by experimental technology and has one day to choose between revenge and reconnecting with the family he neglected.

s03e12.description: A geneticist tests an evolutionary formula on himself and accelerates beyond ordinary humanity, with changes that become increasingly difficult to reverse or contain.

s03e13.description: One of several soldiers sealed in isolated bunkers must decide whether to trigger a global defence system as humanity waits for a possible alien attack.

s03e14.description: A mysterious extraterrestrial transmission fascinates young listeners and begins changing their bodies, forcing adults to decide whether the transformation is infection or adaptation.

s03e15.description: After surviving an accidental gunshot, Becka Paulson becomes unusually intelligent and starts receiving instructions from a photograph that appears to speak directly to her.

s03e16.description: A space-station commander accused of murdering his crew insists that something else lured them to their deaths, leaving investigators to separate madness from an impossible explanation.

s03e17.description: A suburban neighborhood is abruptly transported to an alien world, where residents learn they may be subjects in a test of whether humans are suitable for another species' plans.

s03e18.description: A television journalist prepares to reveal evidence of secret cloning and genetic experiments while powerful interests move to prevent his report from ever reaching the public.

s03e19.description: A man whose genetically enhanced son has become a killer injects himself with the same enhancement serum in an attempt to hunt him before more people die.

s03e20.description: In a future where hunting animals is forbidden, humans pay to hunt obsolete androids whose programming prevents them from fighting back until the rules begin to change.

s03e21.description: Soldiers fighting aliens on a resource-rich world rely on performance-enhancing drugs and discover that their perception of the enemy may depend on what the drug makes them see.

s03e22.description: A desperate man is pulled into a parallel reality populated by alternate versions of himself and ordered to hunt one of them, forcing him to question which life is truly his.
